name: Input
description: Single-line text entry with a visible label, hint and error. It anchors the field anatomy (root, label, control, hint, error) every form component reuses.

props.name: type
props.description: The native input type, such as email, url, search or number.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label, linked to the control.

props.name: hint
props.description: Help text under the control, linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation message. Marks the field invalid and is linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid without a message. Emitted as data-invalid.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Makes the control read-only. It stays focusable.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field required and shows the required mark.
props.a11y: Sets required (and so aria-required) on the control.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text. Never a replacement for the label.

props.name: value
props.description: The value. Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value of an uncontrolled input.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text inside the box before the value, such as a currency or https://.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Text inside the box after the value, such as a unit.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon name before the value, resolved through the icon registry. A slot or node overrides it.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon name after the value, resolved through the icon registry. A slot or node overrides it.

props.name: errorField
props.description: The validation key to read from $errors. Defaults to the wire:model name.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { label: '…', control: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The field: label, box, hint and error.

parts.name: label
parts.description: The visible label, for the control.

parts.name: required
parts.description: The required mark inside the label. Hidden from screen readers; the control is required.

parts.name: box
parts.description: The bordered box around the control, its icons and its prefix and suffix.

parts.name: control
parts.description: The native input. Attributes other than class land here.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the control; typing edits the value.

requirements: The label is always visible and linked with for/id; a placeholder never replaces it.
Hint and error are linked to the control with aria-describedby.
Invalid sets aria-invalid on the control; the error is text, never color alone.
Required sets required on the control; the visual mark is aria-hidden.
Class goes to the root; every other attribute (wire:model, name, autocomplete) goes to the control.
Disabled uses --apui-surface-sunken and --apui-text-disabled, never opacity alone.
Visible focus ring on the box while the control has :focus-visible.
Prefix, suffix and icons sit at the logical start and end, so they swap under RTL.
